name: music-pane
description: A music player beside the chat: your albums and YouTube, a search by title, singer or a line of the lyrics, similar songs after each one, the cover, a progress bar and the lyric line being sung. /music opens it.

library.title: Music folder
library.description: A folder with one subfolder per album. A song is an audio file; a .srt (synced) or .txt of the same name, in the album folder or one level below, holds its lyrics; an image in the album folder is its cover.

channel.title: YouTube channel
channel.description: A channel handle (@name) or URL whose playlists show as albums. Needs yt-dlp.

artist.title: Artist
artist.description: The artist of the music folder: searched with its songs, and taken off the front of YouTube titles.

player.title: mpv
player.description: The mpv executable, by name on the PATH or by full path. It plays the songs, and changes volume and pause while it plays.

ffmpeg.title: ffmpeg
ffmpeg.description: The ffmpeg executable, which makes the small covers.

ytdlp.title: yt-dlp
ytdlp.description: The yt-dlp executable, which searches YouTube and reads its playlists and videos.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the music pane when a session starts. Where /music does not run (the desktop app and other hosts), this or asking Claude for music opens it.
